items.title: German Art Institutions Prepare for a Fight as Far Right Looks to Take Power

items.title: Spain’s Preppy Conservatives Are Having a Moment

items.title: Manitoba Joins List of Canadian Provinces to Stop Changing Clocks
items.summary: A survey of 72,000 residents found that most wanted to stop falling back and springing forward every year. The region will now follow others that have abandoned the practice.

items.title: Scientists Warn of Flood Risks to 8 Himalayan Countries after Nepal Disaster
items.summary: The catastrophe set off alarms in a region with thousands of glaciers spanning eight nations. Better monitoring and cooperation between the countries could save lives, experts say.

items.title: Anthropic Pursues IPO Despite Its A.I. Safety Warnings
